NATIONAL WATER SUPPLY AND DRAINAGE BOARD ACT, No.2 OF 1974
Order under Section 92

BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 92 of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act, No. 02 of 1974, I, Rauff Hakeem, the Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, here by approve, the acquisition of the immovable property, described in the following schedule, as alternative lands are required by the Na-tional Water Supply and Drainage Board, for the construction of Rattota Pump House and the Access Road of Greater Matale Water Supply Project.
